rules: Exclude only manually identified whole reserve plants during explicitly supported date ranges. Exact source row, name, carrier, bus and MW assertions; ambiguity fails closed. No fuzzy matching, inferred outage, generation-based availability, bid refit or spike fit.
overlap: eligibility removes source-unit nameplate from the unscaled source fleet. reconciled removes those units BEFORE rescaling the remaining hard-coal stock to the same reported 15951 MW; never subtract reserve MW again from the already scaled fleet. This is an overlap sensitivity, not proof of the stock series' market-role scope. Gas/lignite retain the stock-control factors.
freeze: Original bids, PV interval correction, wind timing, IRENA commissioning, fixed hydro, demand, network, GSK, links and emergency gate. No public-model replacement. Unmatched reserve blocks remain explicitly unresolved.
verification: Independent ledger/source and offer-volume replay; all 8760 native network, bound, primal-dual and zero-emergency checks. Report all complete price zones, generation allocation bounds, tails and false spikes, including adverse results.
